test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following cities of Tamil Nadu got a Geographical Identification Tag for Turmeric cultivation in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Erode.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Geographical Indication (GI) tag** is granted to products that are special for a particular geographical area.
 
• It also prevents misuse of the popularity of the products by others.
 
• The famous** 'Erode turmeric' **has received a prestigious GI tag from the Geographical Indication Registry of India.
 
• The GI Registry granted the coveted status based on the application filed by **‘Erode Manjal Vanigarkal Matrum Kidangu Urimaiyalargal Sangam’.**
 
• After an** eight-year process**, the Government of India recognized it as a Geographical indication officially since the year 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Erode Turmeric** is known for its **high Curcumin content.**
 
• It is a natural **food coloring agent** as approved by WHO.
 
• Erode Turmeric has about **90% of Curcumin** content for which it is most sought after.
 
• It is also known for its high medicinal value and taste.
 
• **Erode grows the majority of Chinna Nadan. **
 
• It is also the largest market for turmeric.
